english.notes: This offence does not apply to the sale of a product that complies with the requirements of regulation 25 and which is for administration in accordance with regulation 27.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time Limit on Prosecutions
No prosecution shall be begun after the expiry of -

(a) three years from the commission of the offence; or
(b) one year from its discovery by the prosecutor,

whichever is the earlier.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
